description_target.target_text: Translate detached colored pieces into enclosed holes of large container objects

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Jigsaw packing: CONTAINER objects have enclosed background holes;
 ;; the loose non-gray objects are PIECES. Backtracking-search an exact
 ;; cover of every hole by translated pieces (largest pieces first,
 ;; ties by position), then draw containers + placed pieces (in their
 ;; own colors) on a blank canvas. Gray(5) objects are scaffolding and
 ;; disappear.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (sort-cells cells)
       (sort-by cells (lambda (p) (+ (* 100 (first p)) (second p)))))
     (define (holes-of obj)
       ;; 4-connected bg pockets inside the bbox that never reach its edge
       (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
              (own (obj-cells obj))
              (mask (grid-from-fn (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj)
                                  (lambda (r c)
                                    (if (and (zero? (at g (+ r1 r) (+ c1 c)))
                                             (not (member (list (+ r1 r)
                                                                (+ c1 c))
                                                          own)))
                                        1 0)))))
         (map (lambda (o)
                (sort-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (+ r1 (first p))
                                                   (+ c1 (second p))))
                                 (obj-cells o))))
              (filter (lambda (o) (and (> (obj-r1 o) 0) (> (obj-c1 o) 0)
                                       (< (obj-r2 o) (- (obj-h obj) 1))
                                       (< (obj-c2 o) (- (obj-w obj) 1))))
                      (objects mask 0)))))
     (define objs (objects g 0))
     (define records
       (for/list ((idx (range 0 (length objs))))
         (list idx (list-ref objs idx) (holes-of (list-ref objs idx)))))
     (define containers
       (filter (lambda (rec) (and (not (= (obj-color (second rec)) 5))
                                  (not (empty? (third rec)))))
               records))
     (define container-ids (map first containers))
     ;; piece = (id color shape bbox size)
     (define pieces
       (map (lambda (rec)
              (let ((obj (second rec)))
                (list (first rec) (obj-color obj)
                      (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj))
                      (obj-bbox obj) (obj-size obj))))
            (filter (lambda (rec)
                      (and (not (= (obj-color (second rec)) 5))
                           (not (member (first rec) container-ids))))
                    records)))
     (define (piece-id p) (first p))
     (define (piece-color p) (second p))
     (define (piece-shape p) (third p))
     (define all-holes
       (sort-by (flatmap third containers)
                (lambda (cells)
                  (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
                    (+ (* 10000 (first bb)) (* 100 (second bb))
                       (length cells))))))
     (define (translate-shape shape dr dc)
       (sort-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                          (+ (second p) dc)))
                        shape)))
     (define (placements-for hole piece)
       ;; every translation of the piece that lies fully inside the hole
       (remove-duplicates
        (filter (lambda (placed) (all? (lambda (p) (member p hole)) placed))
                (flatmap (lambda (hp)
                           (map (lambda (sp)
                                  (translate-shape (piece-shape piece)
                                                   (- (first hp) (first sp))
                                                   (- (second hp)
                                                      (second sp))))
                                (piece-shape piece)))
                         hole))))
     (define (intersects? a b) (any? (lambda (p) (member p b)) a))
     (define (option-key opt)  ;; big pieces first, then bbox position
       (let ((piece (first opt)) (bb (fourth (first opt))))
         (+ (* -100000 (list-ref piece 4)) (* 1000 (first bb)) (second bb)
            (piece-color piece))))
     (define (cover-hole hole rem)
       ;; exact-cover DFS: always extend at the first uncovered hole cell
       (define (options-for cell covered rem2)
         (sort-by (filter (lambda (opt)
                            (and (member cell (second opt))
                                 (not (intersects? (second opt) covered))))
                          (flatmap (lambda (piece)
                                     (map (lambda (placed)
                                            (list piece placed))
                                          (placements-for hole piece)))
                                   rem2))
                  option-key))
       (define (try-options opts covered rem2 assigns)
         (if (empty? opts)
             #f
             (let* ((piece (first (first opts)))
                    (placed (second (first opts)))
                    (res (dfs (append placed covered)
                              (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (piece-id p)
                                                          (piece-id piece))))
                                      rem2)
                              (append assigns
                                      (list (list (piece-color piece)
                                                  placed))))))
               (or res (try-options (rest opts) covered rem2 assigns)))))
       (define (dfs covered rem2 assigns)
         (let ((todo (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p covered))) hole)))
           (if (empty? todo)
               (list assigns rem2)
               (try-options (options-for (first todo) covered rem2)
                            covered rem2 assigns))))
       (dfs (list) rem (list)))
     (define (fill-holes holes rem assigns)
       (if (empty? holes)
           (list assigns rem)
           (let ((res (cover-hole (first holes) rem)))
             (and res
                  (fill-holes (rest holes) (second res)
                              (append assigns (first res)))))))
     (define base
       (foldl (lambda (rec acc)
                (recolor-cells acc (obj-cells (second rec))
                               (obj-color (second rec))))
              (empty-grid h w 0)
              containers))
     (let ((solved (fill-holes all-holes pieces (list))))
       (foldl (lambda (asg acc) (recolor-cells acc (second asg) (first asg)))
              base
              (if solved (first solved) (list)))))))
